text:
mia_sales: Quick thread for AcmeCorp trial they want Okta SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (~50k initial import, then daily deltas), RBAC via group mapping, domain verification for tenant proofing, and a 2-week Dedicated burst for load testing. Need ops + security + price recs.

owen_se: Clarify: will they do Okta Group Push or SCIM groups? Also are roles sent as a SAML attribute or managed via SCIM group mapping?

sam_acme: We currently use Group Push for a few apps but want SCIM for Redwood. Okta will include a roles claim in SAML; we'll supply CSV for initial import. No JIT provisioning.

owen_se: Recommended POC flow: 1) presigned S3 CSV ingest for the 50k batch (avoids 50k SCIM calls), 2) enable scoped SCIM token for deltas, 3) group->role mapping via JSON config.

claire_security: Security questionnaire blockers: 1) assertion encryption required? We support encrypted assertions (RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM) if SP metadata includes KeyDescriptor for encryption. 2) mTLS for SCIM? Hosted = TLS + scoped token; Dedicated/Private = option for mTLS. 3) Audit logs retention: hosted default 90d, enterprise add-on for 12mo; Dedicated can be set to 12mo.

mia_sales: Procurement asked whether mTLS can be enabled on a hosted trial. If not, they'll likely request Dedicated immediately.

claire_security: mTLS not available on hosted. We can enable mTLS for Dedicated POC. Also will attach SOC2 link and redacted pen-test summary in thread by EOD.

own_se: Example mapping (paste into UI/API):

```
[
  {"okta_group": "acme-admins", "redwood_role": "admin"},
  {"okta_group": "acme-users", "redwood_role": "user"}
]
```

devops-bot: [devops-bot] Presigned S3 URL generated: https://storage.redwood.ai/presign/acme-poc (24h expiry)

mia_sales: Action items: 1) Sam to share SP metadata + S3 IAM role or accept presigned URL by EOD, 2) Claire to post SOC2 & pentest links, 3) Owen to draft pro-rated Dedicated burst quote (daily rate + overage per 1k TPS). We'll reconvene after artifacts. :thumbsup:

sam_acme: Sharing metadata + IAM role now via secure email. Need firm burst number for procurement.

claire_security: Uploaded SOC2 link to internal share (will post public URL if legal approves). Also confirming assertion encryption steps in our Okta guide.

ownen_se: Noted blocker: if Acme insists on mTLS for hosted SCIM, we need legal exception. Otherwise plan Dedicated burst. I'll draft the ops doc and pricing in 24h.

mia_sales: Thanks team closing loop here until we have the artifacts.
